QuestInfo.name: Bringing a Mirror to Heena
QuestInfo.1: You got the mirror from Sarah, who was doing her laundry. You have to take it to Heena.
QuestInfo.2: You got the mirror from Sarah, who was doing her laundry and took it to Heena.

0.0: How am I going to hang all these up? What a hassle. What? You want my mirror? Please don't tell me #p2101# asked you for this...
0.1: Seriously, she should have come to get it herself. She is sooo lazy. Fine, fine, here's the mirror.

no.0: Oh? Why aren't you accepting the mirror? Do you no longer wish to see #p2101#?

1.0: Oh wow! You brought #p2100#'s mirror! Thank you so, so much. Let's see...no skin damage whatsoever... Whew! That's a relief.

yes.0: If you go right, you will see a shiny aura. We call that a Portal. If you press #bup-arrow#k, you will teleport to the next area. So long!

npc.0: It looks like you haven't delivered the mirror to #b#p2101##k yet. Please hurry!

item.0: Did you lose the mirror? Ask my sister for it again then.
